subject: Welcome to University System!
body:
Dear $first_name $last_name,

Welcome to our University System! Your student account has been successfully created.

Here are your account details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Student ID: $student_id
Email: $email_address
Course: $course
Temporary Password: $temp_password
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IMPORTANT: For security purposes, please change your password upon first login.

Getting Started:
• Log into the student portal using your Student ID and temporary password
• Complete your profile information
• Review your enrolled modules
• Check your academic calendar for important dates
• Contact the academic office if you have any questions

Student Services:
• Academic Support: academic.support@university.edu
• IT Helpdesk: it.help@university.edu
• Finance Office: finance@university.edu
• General Inquiries: info@university.edu

We look forward to supporting you throughout your academic journey!

Best regards,
University Administration Team
